detail.program:
network synth_C3_latched_alarm {
  maxdelay 4
  inputs a, r
  inst i0 = window(k=2, w=3) in=a
  inst i1 = relay(d=1) in=r
  inst i2 = latch() set=i0.out rst=i1.out
  output y = i2.out
}
